run_async_health_check: run an async health check on an Azure GPT model using litellm.ahealth_check with model params
test_embedding_health_check: test an Azure text embedding model health check using litellm.ahealth_check in embedding mode
test_image_generation_health_check: test an OpenAI DALL-E 3 image generation health check using litellm.ahealth_check in image_generation mode
